11-A second attribution defect is now measured: the owning lane’s commit `beeb9c7a6c` is tree-identical to its parent. Its source had already been swept into this reviewer run’s system baseline, so the commit subject cannot be counted as a lane-produced source change. I’m keeping contribution counts tied to own-parent tree diffs, not commit prose.
12-The system-integrated Pic0 file is not an unconditional producer either. Its result still assumes the two headline geometric witnesses `hf` and `hcov`; worse, it specializes the divisor representer at genus while the active parameter lane exists precisely because coverage needs the larger admissible parameter. I’m checking whether that makes the current `hcov` binder merely open or already incompatible with landed bounds.
13-With urgent conversations clear, I’m reading the advisory items that define this fleet’s baseline producer, the prior re-spelling tests, the parameter mismatch, and board/import hazards. I’ll leave unrelated AJC notices untouched and mark only the AJCR review context I actually consume.
14-I’m now auditing the fleet-base producer itself, not accepting I-1788’s report. The static pass checks every explicit and typeclass binder on `divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy` and follows its construction far enough to rule out a hidden representability witness; the kernel and axiom probes will wait for a released AJCR slot.
15-The AJCR Lake mutex is genuinely occupied: a root build and a separate parameter-check are running, with several long-running Lean jobs. I will not start another compiler process. While they finish, I’m completing the source-only producer classification and board audit.
16-The parameter lane has made a real off-diagonal generalization at the pinch/pack layer, but it has not yet reached any representer consumer. Three new `_at gamma n` lemmas are themselves weaker corollaries of later degree-keyed lemmas and currently have no consumers; the real advance is the six underlying decoupled statements plus the positive `windowBound` rewire. I’m sending that distinction to the owner before it reports a producer.
17:The static binder audit separates the headline signal from syntax: there are four fully witness-free declarations at both base and HEAD (the genus representer pair and the two degree-zero terminal representations). The broader no-RepresentableBy-antecedent census moves 19 to 20, but the added declaration is conditional on `hf` and `hcov`, so genuine unconditional reach remains flat.
18-The baseline audit is complete: the fleet has added zero genuine unconditional producers and zero consumer declarations so far. I’m now reconciling owner replies and checking whether the AJCR build lock has cleared so I can run the independent import and axiom probes without disrupting the three prover lanes.
19-The parameter owner confirms the first off-diagonal consumers now compile, but correctly withholds producer credit until the admissible representer and Abel consumer land. I’m recording that distinction and closing the review thread; the AJCR module build is still live, so Lake probes remain deferred.
20-A new parameter-lane commit landed while I was reconciling the thread. I’m freezing that SHA separately and checking its declaration delta now; this avoids crediting a moving worktree or the system’s earlier swept baseline to the wrong lane.
21-The new commit is honest parameter plumbing, not representability progress: it adds mixed `gamma ≤ degree` fibre lemmas but no `RepresentableBy` result or `(rep :)` consumer. The frozen metric at `ed18792c65` therefore remains 4 genuine producers and 143 consumer declarations, identical to the fleet base.
22-I’m publishing the frozen round-0 audit to the task ledger now. It separates measured counts from the source-level inference and explicitly leaves the final build/axiom verdict open until the prover fleet releases the mutex.
23-The top `AJCR.w4-rep` roadmap summary is indeed stale: it still says no divisor-representability witness exists, despite the landed genus producer. I’m checking the non-destructive roadmap update interface so the correction preserves the historical audit and does not touch any owned child row.
--
26-The audited unit is committed as `454409d44d` using a private index and a compare-and-swap update; its parent changed during the commit, so no concurrent work was overwritten. Two additional fleet commits landed before that CAS, and I’m auditing those deltas before treating the snapshot as current.
27-The two later parameter commits also add no producer or representability-binder consumer. While the build continues, I’m reviewing the two cited re-spelling incidents directly so the final interderivability test follows the same failure criterion instead of relying on their summaries.
28-The re-spelling criterion is now pinned to the consumer site: both directions must be tested with all structure fields available there, not merely compared as abstract binder lists. For this round, the Pic0 addition is a direct specialization of the existing chart theorem, while the fibre addition is only a downstream algebra lemma; neither qualifies as a new unconditional producer.
29-The final boundary check found no unread conversations. Three cited review memories were marked consumed after the prior commit, so I’m committing only those read-state records now; this keeps the session from ending with uncommitted Horizon state and still avoids the polluted shared index.

     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroRep
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The widened degree-zero divisor functor is terminal
    12	
    13	The unit-equation proof for degree-zero certified divisors uses only the finite cover, its joint
    14	coverage, and the equalizer certificate.  It therefore applies verbatim to arbitrary affine-open
    15	covers.  Descending the result through the widened local-certification predicate makes every
    16	degree-zero widened divisor value a singleton and represents the functor by the terminal object.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
    32	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    33	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    34	
    35	noncomputable section
    36	
    37	namespace AffAdaptation
    38	
    39	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    40	  (A : AffAdaptation D d)
    41	
    42	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
    43	/-- The constant section belongs to the widened glued equalizer. -/
    44	theorem one_mem_gluedSubmodule : (1 : A.chartProd) ∈ A.gluedSubmodule := by
    45	  rw [A.mem_gluedSubmodule_iff]
    46	  intro p
    47	  change A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 1 = A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 1
    48	  rw [map_one, map_one]
    49	
    50	/-- A widened degree-zero certificate forces every adapted equation to be a unit. -/
    51	theorem isUnit_eqn_of_isCertified_zero (hc : A.IsCertified 0) (j : D.index) :
    52	    IsUnit (A.eqn j) := by
    53	  haveI := hc.finite_glued
    54	  haveI := hc.projective_glued
    55	  haveI : Module.Flat R A.Glued := Module.Flat.of_projective
    56	  haveI : Subsingleton A.Glued :=
    57	    Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_iff_subsingleton.mp (funext fun p => hc.rankAtStalk_glued p)
    58	  have h0 : (⟨(1 : A.chartProd), A.one_mem_gluedSubmodule⟩ : A.Glued) = 0 :=
    59	    Subsingleton.elim _ _
    60	  have hj : (1 : A.colength j) = 0 := congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h0) j
    61	  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top (x := A.eqn j), Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    62	  have hmk : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) 1 = 0 := hj
    63	  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hmk
    64	
    65	/-- A widened degree-zero certified system is divisor-equal to the trivial system. -/
    66	theorem divEq_trivEqns_of_isCertified_zero (hc : A.IsCertified 0) :
    67	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d (DivFamZar.trivEqns C R) := by
    68	  classical
    69	  choose piece hpiece using D.exists_mem_pieces
    70	  refine ⟨⟨fun y => D.pieces (piece y) ⊓ d.cover.opens y,
    71	      fun y => ⟨hpiece y, d.cover.mem_opens y⟩⟩,
    72	    fun y => inf_le_right, fun _ => le_top, fun y => ?_⟩
    73	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel (piece y) y
    74	  have hL : IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE
    75	      (inf_le_left : D.pieces (piece y) ⊓ d.cover.opens y
    76	        ≤ D.pieces (piece y))).op).hom (A.eqn (piece y))) :=
    77	    (A.isUnit_eqn_of_isCertified_zero hc (piece y)).map _
    78	  rw [hu] at hL
    79	  have hunit : IsUnit (((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE
    80	      (inf_le_right : D.pieces (piece y) ⊓ d.cover.opens y
    81	        ≤ d.cover.opens y)).op).hom (d.eqn y)) :=
    82	    isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hL
    83	  refine ⟨hunit.unit, ?_⟩
    84	  rw [DivFamZar.trivEqns_eqn, map_one, mul_one]
    85	  exact hunit.unit_spec.symm
    86	
    87	end AffAdaptation
    88	
    89	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    90	-- The finite localization cover and relative-curve cover are transported through `ULift`.
    91	/-- A widened locally certified degree-zero system is divisor-equal to the trivial system. -/
    92	theorem divEq_trivEqns_of_isLocallyCertifiedAff_zero
    93	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff 0 d) :
    94	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d (DivFamZar.trivEqns C R) := by
    95	  classical
    96	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hG⟩ := hd
    97	  set f' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → R := fun i => f i.down with hf'
    98	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range f') = ⊤ := by
    99	    rw [← hspan]
   100	    congr 1
   101	    exact Set.ext fun x =>
   102	      ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i.down, hi⟩, fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨ULift.up i, hi⟩⟩
   103	  haveI : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
   104	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (f' i))) :=
   105	    fun i => isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (f' i)) (f' i)
   106	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback
   107	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (f' i)))
   108	    (fun y => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R f'
   109	      (fun i => Localization.Away (f' i)) hspan' y)
   110	    (fun i => Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   111	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (f' i))) d)
   112	    (fun i => Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   113	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (f' i))) (DivFamZar.trivEqns C R))
   114	    (fun i => ?_)
   115	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
   116	  exact (hGdiv.symm.trans
   117	      (G.adaptation.divEq_trivEqns_of_isCertified_zero G.certified)).trans
   118	    (divEq_pullback_trivEqns _ _).symm
   119	
   120	instance instSubsingletonDivFamZarAffZero : Subsingleton (DivFamZarAff C R 0) := by
   121	  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
   122	  induction x using Quotient.ind with | _ d1 =>
   123	  induction y using Quotient.ind with | _ d2 =>
   124	  exact Quotient.sound
   125	    ((divEq_trivEqns_of_isLocallyCertifiedAff_zero d1.2).trans
   126	      (divEq_trivEqns_of_isLocallyCertifiedAff_zero d2.2).symm)
   127	
   128	namespace DivFamZarAff
   129	
   130	/-- The trivial widened degree-zero class. -/
   131	noncomputable def trivZarAff : DivFamZarAff C R 0 :=
   132	  (DivFamZar.trivFam C R pi).toAff.toZarAff
   133	
   134	theorem mapAlgHom_trivZarAff {A A' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	    [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A'] (phi : A →ₐ[k] A') :
   136	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom phi (trivZarAff (C := C) (pi := pi) (R := A)) =
   137	      trivZarAff (C := C) (pi := pi) (R := A') :=
   138	  Subsingleton.elim _ _
   139	
   140	/-- The constant trivial class is a widened degree-zero section on every test. -/
   141	noncomputable def trivSectionAff (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : divFamZarAff C 0 T :=
   142	  ⟨fun _ => trivZarAff (C := C) (pi := pi),
   143	    fun _ _ h => mapAlgHom_trivZarAff (C := C) (pi := pi) (Over.resAlgHom T h)⟩
   144	
   145	end DivFamZarAff
   146	
   147	instance instSubsingletonDivFamZarAffSectionZero (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   148	    Subsingleton (divFamZarAff C 0 T) :=
   149	  ⟨fun _ _ => Subtype.ext (funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
   150	
   151	/-- The widened degree-zero divisor functor is represented by the terminal object. -/
   152	noncomputable def divFunctorAffZeroRepresentableBy :
   153	    (divFunctorAff C 0).RepresentableBy (Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))) where
   154	  homEquiv {T} :=
   155	    { toFun := fun _ => DivFamZarAff.trivSectionAff (C := C) (pi := pi) T
   156	      invFun := fun _ => Over.mkIdTerminal.from T
   157	      left_inv := fun f => Over.mkIdTerminal.hom_ext _ f
   158	      right_inv := fun _ =>
   159	        (instSubsingletonDivFamZarAffSectionZero T).allEq _ _ }
   160	  homEquiv_comp {T _} _ _ :=
   161	    (instSubsingletonDivFamZarAffSectionZero T).allEq _ _
   162	
   163	end
   164	
   165	end AlgebraicGeometry

     1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroGeneral
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarSheaf
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# A PRODUCER OF `rep` AT PARAMETER `0`
    11	
    12	`rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D` is the hypothesis the whole Pic⁰ seam is
    13	quantified over — `mixedParamChart` takes one per index — and it has had **no producer at any
    14	parameter**.  This file supplies one at `n = 0`.
    15	
    16	## The two halves, and where each comes from
    17	
    18	* **Inhabited.**  `DivFamZar.trivZar` and `DivFamZar.trivSection`
    19	  (`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZero.lean`) give a point of `divFamZar C π 0 T` at every test,
    20	  unconditionally.  Not this file's work.
    21	* **Unique.**  `DivisorAdaptation.divEq_trivEqns_of_isCertified_zero`
    22	  (`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroGeneral.lean`) says a degree-`0` certified system is
    23	  divisor-equal to the trivial one, over an **arbitrary** test ring — the unit argument, no
    24	  field.  Descending it through `IsLocallyCertified` is the work below.
    25	
    26	Together the value is a singleton at every test object, so `divFunctor C π 0` is the terminal
    27	presheaf on the slice, and the terminal object `Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k))` represents it.
    28	
    29	## Why the descent is not free, and what pays for it
    30	
    31	`DivFamZar` is defined by `IsLocallyCertified`: a span-`⊤` family `g : Fin m → R` with
    32	certified families over the localizations `Localization.Away (g i)`, each divisor-equal to the
    33	*pulled-back* system.  So the unit argument applies over each `Localization.Away (g i)`, not
    34	over `R`, and the conclusion has to come back down.  It does, through two landed facts:
    35	
    36	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback` — divisor equality is local for a cover by
    37	  open immersions (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZariskiSep.lean`);
    38	* `exists_relCurveMap_base_eq` — the localization comparisons of a span-`⊤` family jointly
    39	  cover the relative curve.
    40	
    41	Both were built for `DivFam.eq_of_away_eq` and are reused verbatim.  The one bookkeeping step
    42	is the index universe: `IsLocallyCertified` uses `Fin m : Type 0` while the descent lemma wants
    43	`ι : Type u`, so the family is transported along `ULift`.
    44	
    45	## What this does and does not give the seam
    46	
    47	**Does**: a genuine `(divFunctor C π 0).RepresentableBy`, and hence — per pic-c's
    48	`abel-noninj` work, which takes `Subsingleton ((divFunctor C π n).obj (op T))` as its
    49	antecedent — an inhabitant of the antecedent that makes the Abel chart a monomorphism at this
    50	parameter.  The `rep` slot is no longer producerless.
    51	
    52	**Does not**: give `mixedParamChart` an atlas at a useful parameter.  A chart at `nn i = 0`
    53	still needs a legal index `Z i` of degree `m·d₁ − 0`, and the seam's coverage antecedent is
    54	untouched.  This is one antecedent discharged, not the seam closed.
    55	-/
    56	
    57	set_option autoImplicit false
    58	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling. -/
    59	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    60	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161); pin in-file. -/
    61	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    62	
    63	universe u
    64	
    65	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    66	
    67	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    68	
    69	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    70	
    71	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    72	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    73	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    74	
    75	noncomputable section
    76	
    77	/-! ## The pullback of the trivial system is trivial -/
    78	
    79	/-- **The trivial system pulls back to the trivial system**, up to divisor equality, along an
    80	arbitrary comparison of relative curves.  Both have cover `⊤` and the pulled equation is a
    81	restriction of `1`, so the comparison unit is `1`.
    82	
    83	This is the mirror of `DivFamZar.mapAlg_trivZar` at the level of *systems* rather than classes,
    84	and it is what lets the descent below compare like with like on each localization. -/
    85	theorem divEq_pullback_trivEqns {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    86	    (w : relCurve C S ⟶ relCurve C R) (hreg) :
    87	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
    88	      ((DivFamZar.trivEqns C R).pullback w hreg) (DivFamZar.trivEqns C S) := by
    89	  refine ⟨⊤, fun _ => le_top, fun _ => le_top, fun y => ⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
    90	  rw [Units.val_one, one_mul, Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback_eqn, DivFamZar.trivEqns_eqn]
    91	  change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) (1 : _))
    92	      = (CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) (1 : _)
    93	  rw [map_one, map_one, map_one]
    94	
    95	/-! ## The descent to the locally certified carrier -/
    96	
    97	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    98	-- The `IsLocallyCertified` destructuring plus the four descent arguments elaborate past the
    99	-- default heartbeat budget; scoped to this one declaration rather than to the whole file.
   100	/-- **A locally certified degree-`0` system is divisor-equal to the trivial one**, over an
   101	arbitrary test ring.
   102	
   103	The unit argument (`divEq_trivEqns_of_isCertified_zero`) applies over each
   104	`Localization.Away (g i)`, where `IsLocallyCertified` supplies a genuine certified family; the
   105	conclusion descends because divisor equality is local for the cover by the localization
   106	comparisons, which are open immersions jointly covering the relative curve.
   107	
   108	Field-free: the corresponding field statement `divEq_of_isCertified_zero`
   109	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroUnique.lean`) needs `Field K` for
   110	`divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq`, and this route needs no such input. -/
   111	theorem divEq_trivEqns_of_isLocallyCertified_zero
   112	    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R pi 0 d) :
   113	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d (DivFamZar.trivEqns C R) := by
   114	  classical
   115	  obtain ⟨m, g, hspan, hG⟩ := hd
   116	  -- `IsLocallyCertified` indexes by `Fin m : Type 0`; the descent lemma wants `Type u`
   117	  set g' : ULift.{u} (Fin m) → R := fun i => g i.down with hg'
   118	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range g') = ⊤ := by
   119	    rw [← hspan]
   120	    congr 1

   158	/-- **Two `D.left`-points over one test with the same chart value refute the certificate.**

   221	  set x₂ : T.left ⟶ D.left := (rep.homEquiv.symm s₂).left with hx₂

   224	  have hs₂ : x₂ ≫ D.hom = T.hom := Over.w _

   230	    rfl
   231	  have hrec₂ : rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x₂ (hstruct.symm.trans hs₁)) = s₂ := by
   232	    refine (congrArg rep.homEquiv (Over.OverMorphism.ext ?_)).trans
   233	      (rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply s₂)
   234	    rfl
   235	  refine not_isChartLocusFibre_of_points rep m Z hdeg x₁ x₂ ?_ hstruct ?_
   236	  · -- distinct families give distinct points, `rep.homEquiv.symm` being injective
   237	    intro h
   238	    exact hne (hrec₁.symm.trans ((congrArg rep.homEquiv
   239	      (Over.OverMorphism.ext h)).trans hrec₂))
   240	  · -- the two chart values are `hval` restricted along the identity-on-`T.left` slice
   241	    -- morphism `e`, so naturality of `chartValue` transports it

   243	      Over.homMk (𝟙 T.left) ((Category.id_comp T.hom).trans hs₁.symm) with he

   246	      Over.OverMorphism.ext (Category.id_comp x₁).symm

   249	      Over.OverMorphism.ext (Category.id_comp x₂).symm

    "body": "CLAIM ajcr-pic0-join: AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.datum-tail

    "id": "I-1734",
    "body": "DAT-J hard-codes degree g where Milne uses a large degree n

- Measured source: Milne III §4 (Abelian Varieties, document p.99 / PDF p.105) fixes a rational point after the permitted finite separable extension and chooses n > 2g for representability/completeness; degree g begins only in §5 birationality.
- Measured Lean: `JacobianDataAbelSquare.lean:117-159`, `DivisorFamilyFieldSurj.lean:198-223`, and `JacobianDataAbelEffectivePoint.lean:137-168` require exact degree g. The landed `JacobianDataAbelDegreeWindow.lean:138-178,248-258` supports n >= g, but `#check exists_effective_deg_eq_of_le_classDeg` fails under the square import closure and succeeds only with the window import.
- Action: assign the unowned `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-j.large-degree-abel-source` row before treating DAT-J as source-faithful; keep DAT-G pointed-extension/descent explicit.",
    "comments": []
  },
  {
    "id": "I-1642",
    "body": "A THREE-LANE COMPOSITION IS INVISIBLE TO EVERY PER-ROW CHECK, AND THE ROWS WILL EACH TELL YOU THE WORK IS ELSEWHERE.

WHAT HAPPENED (pic-e, AJC, 0095 r6). Three sorry-free theorems from three different lanes composed into a verbatim derivation of the project's central sorry from the classical pointed theorem: the unconditional finite-GALOIS-level rational point (Curve/), the picSharp->picEt transport (PicEtSubcanonical), and the lftFree descent step with hq and hcov already internal (PicEtGaloisQuotient). Eleven declarations, all axiom-clean, three commits.

NO ROW MENTIONED THE OTHER TWO. The descent-assembly row listed FOUR open inputs; three were already discharged elsewhere. The seam docstring's own 'what remains' sentence listed three items, one of which was closed and one of which was DONE-AND-CALLED-REMAINING. Every row was individually plausible and internally consistent; the composition existed only across them.

THE MECHANISM, and why the usual checks miss it: each row is maintained by the lane that owns it, and a lane records what IT owes, not what another lane has since supplied. So a row goes stale in the CHEAP direction -- it schedules work that exists -- and nothing re-reads it, because a list of remaining obligations reads as self-criticism. Same asymmetry as [[gap-list-is-the-least-audited-prose]] and [[unavoidable-is-not-geometric]], but distributed: no single sentence is wrong enough to notice.

THE CHECK THAT FINDS IT, and it is cheap: take the consumer theorem's LITERAL binder list -- #check the one a costing tells you to aim at -- and ask of EACH binder, separately, 'does a producer for exactly this exist at HEAD?'. Not 'is this gap open' (the row answers that) but 'is this BINDER discharged'. At the spelling that matters, seamClauseOne_of_hasGaloisQuotient_lftFree, three of four were gone and the fourth was an instance binder no row named. A four-item gap list and a one-item binder list were both accurate about different things.

COROLLARY, the part that cost me a withdrawal: after composing, price the RESULT against the WEAKEST antecedent your proof consumes, not the shape the hand-off wants. My first antecedent carried IsSeparated, which is provably free from the conclusion's own representation, and a reduction whose antecedent contains a free conjunct misreports exactly the number it exists to report. Related: [[price-the-consumer-carrier]], [[audit-the-goals-antecedents-not-the-lemmas]].",
    "comments": []
  },
  {
    "id": "I-1721",
    "body": "VANISHING-VOCABULARY SPELLINGS ARE ONE ANTECEDENT -- and the commit that ships the 'reduced' producer often ships the iff that proves it is a re-spelling.

  _of_forall_isEmpty_schematicSupport : IsEmpty(schematicSupport x.F)
Each docstring bills its antecedent as 'the sharpest/purest/most-geometric honest form.' At every DivFamily x.F is quasicoherent, and the file itself ships isZero_iff_forall_subsingleton_sections and isZero_iff_isEmpty_schematicSupport -- so the three antecedents are PROVABLY EQUIVALENT (all = IsZero x.F).      6	import Mathlib
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Support of a finite module after base change
    10	
    11	For a finite `A`-module `M`, base change to an `A`-algebra `B` neither creates nor
    12	removes support above a prime of `A`.  The reverse implication in
    13	`support_baseChange_finite` is the missing carrier direction needed to compare a
    14	fibre of a schematic support with the schematic support of a fibre.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	open TensorProduct
    20	
    21	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    26	
    27	/-- The support of a finite module commutes with arbitrary base change, pointwise. -/
    28	theorem support_baseChange_finite (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    29	    [Module.Finite A M] (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    30	    q ∈ Module.support B (B ⊗[A] M) ↔
    31	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) q ∈ Module.support A M := by
    32	  set p := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) q with hp
    33	  rw [Module.mem_support_iff_nontrivial_residueField_tensorProduct,
    34	      Module.mem_support_iff_nontrivial_residueField_tensorProduct]
    35	  have hcom : p.asIdeal = q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A B) := rfl
    36	  letI phi : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →+* q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    37	    Ideal.ResidueField.map p.asIdeal q.asIdeal (algebraMap A B) hcom
    38	  letI algPhi : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := phi.toAlgebra
    39	  haveI tower : IsScalarTower A p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
    40	    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    41	    intro a
    42	    change (algebraMap A q.asIdeal.ResidueField) a = phi _
    43	    rw [Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap,
    44	      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B q.asIdeal.ResidueField]
    45	  have cancelB : Nontrivial (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[B] (B ⊗[A] M)) ↔
    46	      Nontrivial (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] M) :=
    47	    (AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A B q.asIdeal.ResidueField
    48	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField M).toEquiv.nontrivial_congr
    49	  have factorResidue : Nontrivial (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] M) ↔
    50	      Nontrivial (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[p.asIdeal.ResidueField]
    51	        (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] M)) :=
    52	    ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    53	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField M).toEquiv.nontrivial_congr).symm
    54	  have faithful : Nontrivial (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[p.asIdeal.ResidueField]
    55	        (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] M)) ↔
    56	      Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] M) :=
    57	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.nontrivial_tensorProduct_iff_right
    58	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField q.asIdeal.ResidueField
    59	  rw [cancelB, factorResidue, faithful]
    60	
    61	/-- Set-level form of `support_baseChange_finite`. -/
    62	theorem support_baseChange_finite_eq (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    63	    [Module.Finite A M] :
    64	    Module.support B (B ⊗[A] M) =
    65	      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) ⁻¹' Module.support A M := by
    66	  ext q
    67	  simpa using support_baseChange_finite M q
    68	
    69	/-- Empty support is preserved by base change for finite modules. -/
    70	theorem support_baseChange_finite_eq_empty_of_isEmpty (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M]
    71	    [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] (h : Module.support A M = ∅) :
    72	    Module.support B (B ⊗[A] M) = ∅ := by
    73	  rw [support_baseChange_finite_eq, h, Set.preimage_empty]
    74	
    75	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	## Main declarations
    22	
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
    24	  genus-parameter divisor representer.
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
    27	  source opens.
    28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` represents `pic0TypeFunctor C`
    29	  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
    30	-/
    31	
    32	set_option autoImplicit false
    33	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    34	
    35	universe u
    36	
    37	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    38	
    39	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    40	
    41	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the chosen genus-parameter representer. -/
    48	def universalDivFamAffGenus :
    49	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
    50	  (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    51	
    52	/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the
    53	corresponding morphism into the genus representer. -/
    54	theorem universalDivFamAffGenus_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    55	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    56	    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) q (universalDivFamAffGenus C)
    57	      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    58	  have h := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    59	    (𝟙 (divRepAffGenusScheme C))
    60	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    61	  exact h.symm
    62	
    63	/-- The widened Abel chart at the genus parameter, using the challenge curve's chosen divisor
    64	representer rather than accepting a representability witness as an argument. -/
    65	def abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    66	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    67	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    68	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ)) :
    69	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
    70	  abelSigmaChartAff C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg
    71	
    72	/-- The structure morphism read from a genus-parameter widened Abel chart is the structure
    73	morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
    74	lemma chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    75	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    76	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    77	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    78	    {ι : Type u} (i : ι) :
    79	    chartHom C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChartAffGenus C m Z hdeg) i
    80	      = (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
    81	  chartHom_abelSigmaChartAff (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg i
    82	
    83	/-- A multi-index family of genus-parameter widened Abel charts, restricted to source opens.
    84	Different indices may use different twists and different opens, but they all use the same
    85	unconditional divisor representer. -/
    86	def affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
    87	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    88	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
    89	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
    90	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
    91	    yoneda.obj (V i : Scheme) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
    92	  restrictChart (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)
    93	
    94	/-- The structure morphism of a restricted genus chart is the inclusion of its source open
    95	followed by the structure morphism of the chosen divisor representer. -/
    96	lemma chartHom_affineGenusChart {ι : Type u}
    97	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    98	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
    99	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   100	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
   101	    chartHom C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) i
   102	      = (V i).ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
   103	  change chartHom C (fun _ : ι => restrictChart
   104	    (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i)) i = _
   105	  exact (chartHom_restrictChart
   106	    (abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i)) (V i) i).trans
   107	      (congrArg ((V i).ι ≫ ·)
   108	        (chartHom_abelSigmaChartAffGenus C (m i) (Z i) (hdeg i) i))
   109	
   110	/-- The degree-zero Picard functor is represented by the glued object of any pointwise-covering
   111	family of open genus-parameter widened Abel charts.
   112	
   113	The divisor representation is construction data, not a hypothesis: it is supplied by
   114	`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`.  The two hypotheses are exactly the geometric inputs of
   115	Zariski local representability. -/
   116	def pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts {ι : Type u}
   117	    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   118	    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
   119	      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ))
   120	    (V : ∀ _ : ι, (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens)
   121	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V i))
   122	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :
   123	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   124	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
   125	      (Sigma.desc (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V)) :=
   126	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C _ hcov
   127	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C (affineGenusChart C m Z hdeg V) hf⟩
   128	
   129	end
   130	
   131	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import Mathlib

     8	/-!
     9	# Vanishing of a finite-dimensional quotient fibre in degree zero
    10	
    11	An epimorphism from the structure sheaf is determined by the image of its global
    12	unit section.  Consequently, once the global sections of its target are known to
    13	be finite-dimensional, fibre degree zero forces the target sheaf to vanish.
    14	
    15	The finite-dimensional hypothesis is essential: without it, `Module.finrank`
    16	returns zero for an infinite-dimensional module as well.  This module isolates
    17	the exact algebraic endpoint that a finite-support/coherence argument must feed.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	namespace Scheme.Modules
    29	
    30	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    31	
    32	/-- If the sections over the top open are a subsingleton, then compatible
    33	presheaf-wide sections are a subsingleton. -/
    34	theorem sections_subsingleton_of_subsingleton_top {M : X.Modules}
    35	    [Subsingleton Γ(M, ⊤)] : Subsingleton M.sections := by
    36	  refine ⟨fun s t => PresheafOfModules.sections_ext s t fun U => ?_⟩
    37	  let f : Opposite.op (⊤ : X.Opens) ⟶ U := (homOfLE le_top).op
    38	  rw [← PresheafOfModules.sections_property s f,
    39	    ← PresheafOfModules.sections_property t f]
    40	  congr 1
    41	  have hs : ∀ a b : Γ(M, ⊤), a = b := fun _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
    42	  exact hs (s.val (Opposite.op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
    43	    (t.val (Opposite.op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
    44	
    45	/-- An epimorphic quotient of the structure sheaf with no global sections is
    46	the zero sheaf. -/
    47	theorem isZero_of_epi_unit_of_subsingleton_sections {M : X.Modules}
    48	    (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M) [Epi q]
    49	    [Subsingleton Γ(M, ⊤)] : IsZero M := by
    50	  letI : Subsingleton M.sections :=
    51	    sections_subsingleton_of_subsingleton_top
    52	  apply IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero q
    53	  apply M.unitHomEquiv.injective
    54	  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    55	
    56	/-- A finite-dimensional epimorphic quotient of the structure sheaf whose
    57	global-section dimension is zero is the zero sheaf. -/
    58	theorem isZero_of_epi_unit_of_finrank_zero
    59	    {k : Type u} [Field k] {M : X.Modules}
    60	    [Module k Γ(M, ⊤)] [FiniteDimensional k Γ(M, ⊤)]
    61	    (q : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M) [Epi q]
    62	    (h : Module.finrank k Γ(M, ⊤) = 0) : IsZero M := by
    63	  letI : Subsingleton Γ(M, ⊤) :=
    64	    ⟨fun a b => (finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mp h a).trans
    65	      (finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mp h b).symm⟩
    66	  exact isZero_of_epi_unit_of_subsingleton_sections q
    67	
    68	end Scheme.Modules
    69	
    70	end AlgebraicGeometry
